moments.title: Premier League Matchday 5 Shakes Up Table
moments.blurb: The Premier League's fifth matchday, played September 18-20, saw Manchester City maintain their perfect start, Arsenal lose their unbeaten record, and Brentford secure a shock 3-0 win over Chelsea.

angles.name: General Results
angles.copy: Premier League Matchday 5 brought goals, upsets, and a shake-up at the top! Man City still perfect, but Arsenal's run is over. Who impressed you most?

angles.name: Chelsea Shock
angles.copy: Did anyone see that coming? Brentford stunned Chelsea with a 3-0 victory in Matchday 5. Big statement from the Bees!

angles.name: Chart Topper

moments.title: Autumn Equinox Marks New Season
moments.blurb: Wednesday, September 23, marks the astronomical Autumn Equinox, signalling the official start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere with day and night roughly equal in length.

angles.name: General Autumn
angles.copy: Happy Autumn Equinox! Today marks the official start of astronomical autumn, with equal day and night. Time for cosy jumpers and pumpkin spice everything?

angles.name: UK Traditions
angles.copy: From Stonehenge to London's Primrose Hill, many are marking the Autumn Equinox with ancient traditions and unique events across the UK today.
